Remark
[compact hypersurfaces with non-vanishing Gauss-Kronecker curvature] ↗ ex:dc-ch6-2-4

If $M^n$, $n\geq 2$, is connected, compact, and orientable and admits an immersion into $\mathbb R^{n+1}$ with nonzero Gauss--Kronecker curvature, then its Gauss map is a local diffeomorphism. Compactness makes it a covering of the simply connected sphere, hence $M\cong S^n$.
